request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "Findings so far", "2": "Both composition attempts among the flow-rate variables failed.", "3": "A cross-sectional rank of the smoothed V02-to-V03 ratio showed essentially zero predictive power (mean IC 0.01, HAC t 0.38) in both low and high T regimes.", "4": "It was highly persistent and distinct from base features, so novelty alone did not help.", "5": "A peer-relative three-month shift in V02 versus V04 was weaker still (IC zero, t 0.05) and noisier month to month.", "6": "Lesson: flow-mix levels and short-term mix shifts appear uninformative.", "7": "Next, we suggest testing hours, wages or the stock rate, or conditioning composition on T."}, "hypothesis": "Submission 2's significant negative IC suggests a genuine reversal: groups where V03 rose more than V02, relative to peers, outperform. Testing at a six-month horizon, not the snooped three-month one, checks whether this is robust rather than noise.", "expression": "spread(chg(V03,6),chg(V02,6))"}
